note: Owner ruling 2026-10-27 20:57 (binding): the imperative `Active driver` line only while the loop is clearly live at the cut: one of its own steps (its skill, a gsd-execute-phase it invoked, its gsd-tools run) is mid-turn, or an agent, workflow, teammate, wake-up or background command it launched still runs; the `Was driving` hint in every other case: its turn ended, an interruption, a pause, a stop, a prompt of any kind (a prompt typed mid-turn, from its queue-operation enqueue to its queued_command delivery, a typed status look, /goal or /loop, this plugin's own skill, a shell command typed with !), another session's turn (a cross-session message, a teammate the loop did not start), an API error ending the turn, the session resumed in a new process. A quiet but live loop shown as a hint is accepted. The turn this plugin's checkpoint nudge closes is no stop only in the nudge's [continue] form as the hook adds it (its [halt] sentence wins), and only when that turn asks the user nothing (sessions 40-44, 63); an agent woken by SendMessage is not ended by its earlier run's crossed notification (session 46). A queued prompt ends the loop's live context at its enqueue, but not a prompt the session scheduled itself, and a pause asked still holds until the prompt is delivered (sessions 47, 48, 57, 59, 60, 62); Claude Code's notice that the person stopped background agents is a stop (sessions 58, 61). R1: the outermost loop drives, also past a pause it wrote (session 50); R4: a paused loop is shown, never run. Five sessions in this one worktree each keep their own GSD line and workstream (owner 21:37).
